name: finishing-a-development-branch
title: finishing-a-development-branch
description: Decides how completed work integrates once implementation is done and tests pass: verify the suite, detect the environment, present merge / pull-request / keep / discard options, execute the choice, and clean up the worktree safely.
why: Closes the loop the other workflow skills open — worktrees and plans get you to done; this makes the merge-or-discard decision explicit and the cleanup safe instead of improvised.
